title: Kullui - Wikipedia
text: Kullui (Kullū, also known as Kulvi, Takri: 𑚊𑚰𑚥𑚷𑚱𑚃/𑚊𑚰𑚥𑚷𑚱𑚦𑚯) is Western Pahari language spoken in the Kullu District of the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. For a list of words relating to Kullu Pahari language, see the Kullu Pahari language category of words in Wiktionary, the free dictionary.

title: Pahari culture - Wikipedia
text: Music and dance play a central role in the cultural life of the Pahari regions, within their celebrations, festivals, and rituals. These art forms serve as entertainment as well as linguistic expressions of tradition, emotions, and social unity.
